# A 100.00 USD invoice paid with 250.00 USD out of a USD bank, leaving the
# customer 150.00 of credit.
#
# The shape this exists for: when a later 50.00 invoice takes 50.00 of that
# credit, the carved remainder is 100.00 — the same size as the split that
# settled this invoice, sitting in the same transaction. Anything picking the
# remainder by size alone can reach the settlement first and hand it the
# credit's balance and cost, leaving the customer's real remaining credit with
# no balance at all: 150.00 USD reported against 250.00 held, and the credit
# refused as a basis for having no balance recorded.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_applied_credit_carries_its_basis.py.
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Accounts Receivable USD
	type: Accounts Receivable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Bank:USD
	type: Bank
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "USD"
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:Sales
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:FX Gain
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

customer "C-US"
	name: "US Customer"
	currency: USD

invoice "INV-USD-BIG-OVER"
	customer_id: "C-US"
	currency: USD
	date_opened: 2026-01-05
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-05
		description: "Consulting"
		action: "Hours"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-05
		due: 2026-02-05
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable USD"
		memo: "Invoice INV-USD-BIG-OVER"
		accumulate: true
	payment:
		date: 2026-02-25
		amount: 250
		account: "Assets:Bank:USD"
		prepayment: 150
		memo: "Payment for INV-USD-BIG-OVER"
